hints.title: Game Score Offset State
hints.text: The score difference between Alice and Bob can range from -n to +n. Shift indices by offset n to map non-negative table coordinates.

hints.title: Consecutive Move Restriction
hints.text: Alice cannot play the same creature consecutively. Maintain Alice's previous creature in the DP state to prevent repeat plays.

hints.title: Winning Differential Summation
hints.text: After n rounds, sum all DP configurations where Alice's final score difference exceeds 0 (offset + 1 to 2n).

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: n: length of sequence string s
complexity.notes: State transitions evaluate 4 * (2n + 1) states over n rounds in O(n^2) operations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining 2^n sequence permutations causes exponential TLE.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) memory using rolling difference arrays.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Formulates state-machine DP tracking previous move and bounded cumulative score differential.
